passages.text: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm.
passages.sermon:
This is a song.
This is a psalm.
The choirmaster leads this song.

passages.text: Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
passages.sermon: This is a song for the choirmaster.\r\nThis is a psalm.\r\nAll the earth must make a joyful noise to God.
passages.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ שִׁ֣יר מִזְמ֑וֹר הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִים כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
passages.sermon:
This is a song and a psalm for the choirmaster.
The subject is God.
God is glorious.
Sing about the glory of God's name.
Make God's praise glorious.
passages.original: זַמְּר֥וּ כְבֽוֹד־ שְׁמ֑וֹ שִׂ֥ימוּ כָ֝ב֗וֹד תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God does amazing things.
Tell God, "Your deeds are awesome."
Your power is great.
Your enemies pretend before You because they fear Your strength.
passages.original: אִמְר֣וּ לֵ֭אלֹהִים מַה־ נּוֹרָ֣א מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ בְּרֹ֥ב עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ יְֽכַחֲשׁ֖וּ לְךָ֣ אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
passages.sermon:
All the earth bows down to God.
All the earth sings praise to God.
All the earth sings praise to God's name.
Come and see the works of God.
God does awesome deeds for people.
passages.original: כָּל־ הָאָ֤רֶץ׀ יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭ךָ וִֽיזַמְּרוּ־ לָ֑ךְ יְזַמְּר֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃ לְכ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֑ים נוֹרָ֥א עֲ֝לִילָ֗ה עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.
passages.sermon:
God acted with great power.
God turned the sea into dry land.
People crossed the river on foot.
We rejoiced in God there.
passages.original: הָ֤פַךְ יָ֨ם׀ לְֽיַבָּשָׁ֗ה בַּ֭נָּהָר יַֽעַבְר֣וּ בְרָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
passages.sermon:
God rules forever.
He rules by His power.
God watches all nations with His eyes.
Do not let rebellious people lift themselves up.
Pause and reflect.
All peoples, bless our God.
Let everyone hear the sound of His praise.
passages.original: מֹ֘שֵׁ֤ל בִּגְבוּרָת֨וֹ׀ עוֹלָ֗ם עֵ֭ינָיו בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם תִּצְפֶּ֑ינָה הַסּוֹרְרִ֓ים׀ אַל־ יָרִימוּ לָ֣מוֹ סֶֽלָה׃ בָּרְכ֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝הַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ ק֣וֹל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
passages.sermon: God preserves our lives.\r\nGod keeps our feet from slipping.
passages.original: הַשָּׂ֣ם נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ בַּֽחַיִּ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ נָתַ֖ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
passages.sermon:
God is the one who tests us.
God examines us.
God refines us.
God makes us pure, like silver.
God removes what is not good in us, just as silver is purified.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ בְחַנְתָּ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים צְ֝רַפְתָּ֗נוּ כִּצְרָף־ כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
passages.sermon: God led us into a trap.\r\nGod placed heavy burdens on our backs.

passages.text: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.
passages.sermon:
God tested us.
God allowed people to rule over us.
We suffered under their power.
We passed through fire.
We passed through water.
God brought us out.
God gave us a place of abundance.
passages.original: הִרְכַּ֥בְתָּ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְרֹ֫אשֵׁ֥נוּ בָּֽאנוּ־ בָאֵ֥שׁ וּבַמַּ֑יִם וַ֝תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נוּ לָֽרְוָיָֽה׃

passages.text: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You— the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
passages.sermon:
I will go into Your house.
I will bring burnt offerings.
I will keep my vows to You.
My lips made these vows.
My mouth spoke these promises.
I made these promises when I was in trouble.
passages.original: אָב֣וֹא בֵיתְךָ֣ בְעוֹל֑וֹת אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְךָ֣ נְדָרָֽי׃ אֲשֶׁר־ פָּצ֥וּ שְׂפָתָ֑י וְדִבֶּר־ פִּ֝֗י בַּצַּר־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
passages.sermon:
I will offer You fat animals as burnt offerings.
I will bring the fragrant smoke of rams.
I will offer bulls to You.
I will offer goats to You.
Selah.
Come and listen, all you who fear God.
I will tell what God has done for me.
passages.original: עֹ֘ל֤וֹת מֵחִ֣ים אַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֭ךְ עִם־ קְטֹ֣רֶת אֵילִ֑ים אֶ֥עֱשֶֽׂה בָקָ֖ר עִם־ עַתּוּדִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃ לְכֽוּ־ שִׁמְע֣וּ וַ֭אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־ יִרְאֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
passages.sermon: I cried out to God with my mouth.\r\nI praised God with my tongue.
passages.original: אֵלָ֥יו פִּֽי־ קָרָ֑אתִי וְ֝רוֹמַ֗ם תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist considers his own heart.
If I had loved sin in my heart, God would not have listened to me.
God does not listen when someone holds on to sin in their heart.
passages.original: אָ֭וֶן אִם־ רָאִ֣יתִי בְלִבִּ֑י לֹ֖א יִשְׁמַ֣ע׀ אֲדֹנָֽי׃

passages.text: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
passages.sermon:
God listened to me.
God heard my prayer.
God paid attention to my voice.
God did not ignore my request.
God responded to my prayer.
passages.original: אָ֭כֵן שָׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִ֝קְשִׁ֗יב בְּק֣וֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃

passages.text: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
passages.sermon: God is worthy of praise.\r\nGod did not reject my prayer.\r\nGod did not take away His loving devotion from me.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הֵסִ֘יר תְּפִלָּתִ֥י וְ֝חַסְדּ֗וֹ מֵאִתִּֽי׃
